notes: This is a feature request to extend the HWAggregateToComb pass (which currently converts only hw.array/hw.struct types) to support hw.union-typed values, specifically comb.mux over unions. The maintainer explicitly confirmed "It's not simply implemented" and invited the reporter to implement it, providing design guidance (bitcast plus union_extract/union_create based on the bit layout). The pass fails with a clean dialect-conversion diagnostic on an op outside its designed scope — there is no crash, miscompile, or spec violation, so it is an enhancement, not a defect.
cost_provenance: cost_usd is OpenCode-reported session cost, not an AWS invoice amount
